description.value: Pescadores Bistro is a casual brunch-and-lunch spot in Port Alberni offering a wide-ranging menu from eggs benedict and omelettes to fish tacos and fresh-ground beef burgers. The restaurant sits directly across from the Alberni Inlet and Marina, with seasonal outdoor patio dining and frequent wildlife sightings. It sits on the natural route for cyclists heading to or from Tofino's Long Beach on Vancouver Island's west coast.

address.value: 5093 Johnston Rd, Port Alberni, BC V9Y 5L6
